digest.component_or_area: ticket creation pipeline and event reducer
propositions: Bug tickets created via CLI, MCP, or library must capture the detection channel (env var REBAR_DETECTED_BY or --detected-by flag override) at the create_core seam to enable escape-channel trend analysis.
The detected_by field is normalized (strip + lowercase); empty or whitespace-only values are treated as unset; unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without validation failure.

process_create must project detected_by present-only into compiled state (mirroring source_* blocks), and events lacking the field must reduce byte-identically to pre-change state for backward compatibility.
Jira inbound CREATE events (via apply_inbound_records.py) bypass composer.create_core and intentionally carry no detected_by to avoid mis-attributing the reconciler daemon.
The optional detected_by field must be declared in ticket_state.schema.json and registered in the env-var/docs registry.
Tests must validate env var precedence, normalization edge cases (whitespace, case), reducer projection additivity, and schema round-trips.
